notes.title: Beta Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Name![/h2]
As mentioned before we were going to change the name of the game from Clönk to something else, to help people better find the game. The new name has now been decided and the new name is [b]IRON EVIL[/b]! What do you think of the new name and the new logo?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412368/282c7c376d22857c262671450dc58e00d30a9db8.png[/img]
So what this means is that everything will be renamed to the new name [b]IRON EVIL[/b] both here on Steam and Discord aswell as other social platforms will now be named after the new name. The logos might also change to the new very fancy and flashy logo.

[h2]Participating in Dreamhack Indie Expo[/h2]
The newly renamed and baptized IRON EVIL will appear on Dreamhack Beyond! We're excited to see our game appear there. For this we want to reopen the playtesting for the game during the weekend! To see more of IRON EVIL keep an eye out for the game on Dreamhack.

[h2]Beta-Playtest is Open[/h2]
We know that you've been waitiing long and hard for the playtests to open aswell as a new patch to drop. But the wait is over, with a new name and our participation on Dreamhack we'll open up the first Beta-playtest version! The Playtest duration will be from [u][b]14th Friday - 17th Monday[/b][/u], after that [u]we'll close the playtest again[/u] until the next patch. If you manage to grab the playtest version you'll be able to keep playing that version even after the the playtest ends.

The new Beta-patch features:
[list]
[*] New cool Parts
[*] New items
[*] Minibosses
[*] New Devices
[*] Updated UI
[*] New Music
[*] Balance & Bug Fixes
[*] And Updated Rooms
[/list]
As mentioned, now when we're in the Beta it means that updates and playtests like these will be less and furhther apart. The development for patches will take longer and we thank you for your understanding. There won't be an update every other week, the updates will be announced both here and on other social platforms. The good thing about this is that there will be bigger and more exciting updates like these!

notes.title: Patch Alpha v1.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

For you who have access to the Alpha Playtest we've come with an update based upon the feedback we recieved recently. The following is a list of what we've added/fixed for the patch v1.3.1:

[b][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][/b] [list]
[*] [b]Part: Aim Assist[/b]
- Increased homing strength
- Removed range decrease
- Removed bullet spread increase
[*] [b]Part: Scatter Muzzle[/b]
- Now fires 5 bullets instead of 3
- Fire rate decrease reduced to -40%
[*] [b]Part: Wall Repellant[/b]
- Decreased bounce amount by 1
[*] [b]Added splash damage to explosions[/b]
[*] [b]Reduced boss jank[/b]
[*] [b]Reduced HP on Sniper Enemy[/b]
[/list]
[b][h3]Content Updates[/h3][/b] [list]
[*] [b]Reworked UI to have better gamepad support[/b]
[*] [b]Improved part card text formatting[/b]
[*] [b]Improved shop UI[/b]
[*] [b]Icons for parts with missing icons[/b]
[*] [b]Added timer during gameplay[/b]
[*] [b]Control scheme now changes automatically[/b]
[*] [b]Improved visibility on destructibles[/b]
[/list]
[b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b] [list]
[*] [b]Fixed shop exploits[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed granade collision[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed some creates retaining it's color during Time Stop[/b]
[/list]
Next we'll conduct some changes in our work strategy so it might be a while before there'll be a new version you can try and give feedback. If you'd like more updates and connect with us, you can do so via our [url=https://discord.gg/Rarhev9B42]Discord Community Server[/url].

Best Regards
Iron Evil Studio
